lines.text: The writer investigates everything from the beginning and writes an orderly account so Theophilus may know the certainty of what he was taught.
In the time of Herod king of Judea, the priest Zechariah and his wife Elizabeth, a descendant of Aaron, had no children.
Zechariah was chosen by lot to burn incense in the temple, and an angel appeared at the left side of the altar.
The angel said Elizabeth would bear a son named John, who would go before the Lord in the spirit and power of Moses.
Gabriel told Zechariah he would be unable to speak until the day this comes to pass, because he did not believe.
